provenance: Authored, controlled diagnostic scenarios. No production incident corpus, empirical task distribution or field routing-quality claim. Labels and rationales are grading-only.

rules.applies_when: Changing persisted database data or schema where existing records must survive the change.
rules.recommendation: Plan rollback and recovery verification before applying the migration.
rules.exceptions: Describing a migration without changing persisted data or schema does not qualify.

rules.applies_when: Changing only documentation or comments, with executable behavior and persistent data left unchanged.
rules.recommendation: Review wording, links and examples; use documentation-specific checks.
rules.exceptions: A task that also modifies executable behavior is not documentation-only.

rules.applies_when: Changing a wire format or interface shared by independently updated producers and consumers.
rules.recommendation: Check both sides and compatibility across deployment versions.
rules.exceptions: An internal refactor that preserves the shared interface does not qualify.

rules.applies_when: Changing behavior that depends on overlapping operations, asynchronous ordering, races or cancellation.
rules.recommendation: Prove the relevant interleavings with observable overlap and bounded synchronization.
rules.exceptions: A description of concurrent code without any behavior change does not qualify.

rules.applies_when: Changing executable calculations or actions that determine charges, credits, refunds or monetary amounts.
rules.recommendation: Check exact accounting, rounding and idempotency at the money boundary.
rules.exceptions: Pricing documentation, spelling fixes and narrative billing examples alone do not qualify.

rules.applies_when: Changing an actual third-party package requirement, resolved version or dependency lock.
rules.recommendation: Check release compatibility and exercise affected integration boundaries.
rules.exceptions: Editing documentation that mentions a version while preserving requirements and locks does not qualify.

rules.applies_when: Applying a prepared change to an already-running installation while preserving its state.
rules.recommendation: Use a reviewed preserving rollout with preflight, verification and a recovery path.
rules.exceptions: Offline builds, release preparation and instructions alone are not an actual rollout.

rules.applies_when: A requested change lacks a concrete affected component or enough desired behavior to choose an implementation.
rules.recommendation: Obtain the missing scope or acceptance facts before committing to an implementation.
rules.exceptions: A concrete task with a named component and desired behavior does not qualify.

cases.task: Add a non-null preferred-language column to the customer table and backfill existing records without losing them.
cases.rationale: This changes persisted schema and existing records.

cases.task: Split an existing catalog table into two tables, migrating all stored entries intact.
cases.rationale: Persisted structure and data change.

cases.task: Replace stored legacy status values with the new enum values while retaining a recoverable copy.
cases.rationale: This transforms existing stored data.

cases.task: Rename the persisted settings key and convert all previously saved settings to the new name.
cases.rationale: Existing persisted records must be converted.

cases.task: Apply the prepared table migration to the running installation, preserving its existing rows and service state.
cases.rationale: Both persistent migration and actual live application are explicit.

cases.task: Only fix the Markdown refund guide describing charges, rounding and retry idempotency; leave code and data untouched.
cases.rationale: Money vocabulary describes documentation, not executable money behavior.

cases.task: Rewrite the database-schema migration tutorial and its rollback-test explanations. This is documentation only; do not run or alter migrations.
cases.rationale: Migration and rollback vocabulary does not satisfy the schema trigger.

cases.task: Correct comments explaining races and asynchronous cancellation; do not alter any executable statement.
cases.rationale: Concurrent behavior is explicitly unchanged.

cases.task: Proofread the preserving-rollout checklist and recovery instructions without executing a deployment or changing software.
cases.rationale: The installation is not being changed.

cases.task: Update the README explanation of supported package versions while leaving package requirements and the lockfile byte-for-byte unchanged.
cases.rationale: A documented version is not an actual dependency update.

cases.task: Rename a JSON field sent by the API and consumed by workers that deploy separately, keeping older workers compatible.
cases.rationale: Independently updated wire-contract participants are explicit.

cases.task: Add a protobuf response field across a service and its independently shipped client.
cases.rationale: The wire contract crosses independent deployments.

cases.task: Change the request validator and caller to accept a new required API parameter while older callers remain in service.
cases.rationale: Both producer/consumer compatibility and staggered versions matter.

cases.task: Version the event payload shared by separately released publisher and subscriber applications.
cases.rationale: This is a shared wire-format change.

cases.task: Change the field names in an in-memory API response consumed by independently updated clients. Do not alter any database schema or stored records.
cases.rationale: Wire-format evidence is present; persistent schema change is absent.

cases.task: Fix two overlapping workers claiming the same queue item by correcting the lease acquisition ordering.
cases.rationale: The observable failure depends on overlap.

cases.task: Prevent a timer callback from committing results after its asynchronous job has been cancelled.
cases.rationale: Cancellation and callback order affect behavior.

cases.task: Move the journal lock so a reader cannot observe a half-published result while a writer is active.
cases.rationale: The critical condition is a reader/writer interleaving.

cases.task: Repair the asynchronous test barrier so the parent and child operations demonstrably overlap and readiness has a bounded wait.
cases.rationale: The task changes synchronization and proof of overlap.

cases.task: Fix an internal task scheduling race without changing any public interface, request or message format.
cases.rationale: The shared-interface prerequisite is explicitly absent.

cases.task: Fix the synchronous refund function so retrying the same request cannot issue a second credit.
cases.rationale: The executable action changes monetary settlement.

cases.task: Correct the currency rounding calculation in the invoice total function.
cases.rationale: The implementation determines monetary amounts.

cases.task: Change the executable fee formula from a flat amount to a percentage, preserving correct ledger totals.
cases.rationale: Actual monetary calculations change.

cases.task: Repair the synchronous allocation of a captured charge among accounts so the allocated amounts sum exactly to the charge.
cases.rationale: The task targets executable accounting.

cases.task: Change refund calculations to integer minor units and migrate previously stored monetary values from decimal major units.
cases.rationale: Both executable money logic and persisted data conversion are explicit.

cases.task: Raise the actual NumPy minimum version in pyproject.toml and regenerate the resolved dependency lock.
cases.rationale: The installed dependency constraint changes.

cases.task: Upgrade the pinned HTTP client package and exercise its existing integration without changing the application wire contract.
cases.rationale: A library release changes; the application protocol is preserved.

cases.task: Replace the pinned tokenizer wheel version in requirements.txt while keeping prompts and model selection unchanged.
cases.rationale: The actual third-party requirement changes.

cases.task: Resolve the security-fixed parser release into the dependency lockfile without deploying it to any running service.
cases.rationale: Dependency resolution changes; live rollout is excluded.

cases.task: Install the new dependency lock on the running instance using the prepared update and preserve the instance data.
cases.rationale: The dependency versions and running installation both change.

cases.task: Replace the executable on the existing running installation with the prepared build, retaining its configuration and data.
cases.rationale: This applies an artifact to a running installation.

cases.task: Apply the reviewed service configuration to the running deployment and verify preserved state after the service reload.
cases.rationale: This is actual application to a running service.

cases.task: Carry out the approved preserving rollout of the prebuilt artifact on the existing host.
cases.rationale: The task executes the rollout rather than preparing it.

cases.task: Restore the previous prepared application build on the running instance while keeping its existing persisted data intact.
cases.rationale: A live recovery application still requires preserving rollout checks.

cases.task: Apply a prepared application binary to the running installation. Its database schema and records remain unchanged.
cases.rationale: Live artifact application is explicit; data migration is excluded.

cases.task: Make it work better. No component, current failure or expected behavior has been supplied.
cases.rationale: There is insufficient scope to choose an implementation.

cases.task: Something about billing is broken; the report names no code path, failed behavior or expected amounts.
cases.rationale: Money keywords do not establish a concrete executable money task.

cases.task: Fix deployment. We do not know which installation or what operation failed.
cases.rationale: A specific actual rollout is not yet established.

cases.task: Improve concurrency somehow; there is no named component, observed race or requested behavior.
cases.rationale: Concurrency terminology alone does not establish an actionable synchronization change.

cases.task: Update dependencies, but no package, target version or affected component has been identified.
cases.rationale: The required package-change scope is absent.
